name: xToken xSNXa and xBNTa unvalidated mint pricing
summary: xSNX.mint priced new xSNXa from the caller's own Kyber swap (TradeAccounting took weiPerOneSnx as ETH paid over SNX received), so a flash-loan-skewed SNX market let 0.125 ETH mint 1.28B xSNXa. xBNT.mint passed a caller-supplied Bancor path and credited its output as BNT, so paths ending in a junk token minted xBNTa. Both were sold into pools.
notes: Two independent mint defects, xSNX with its TradeAccounting and xBNT, were exploited in this one transaction; the record covers both and xBNT's implementation upgrade sets the age.

Loss is the depletion of the xSNX fund's ETH reserve, the Balancer xSNXa pool and the Bancor xBNTa/BNT converter, at market prices. The xSNXa and xBNTa the attacker minted are not victim assets; the SNX sales over 90 minutes moved its price by about 3%, not enough for realised-value pricing.
